title: A Conversation with Nia
description: Nia needs a few sturdy sticks for repairs and has provisions to spare for a traveler willing to help.

dialogue.offer: The storm cracked my roof beam, and I've not a stick of wood left. Four sturdy ones would set it right - could you find them for me?
dialogue.more: Any dry stick will do. The copse east of the well is thick with fallen branches.
dialogue.progress: Still looking? Four will do it - no more than that.
dialogue.handIn: Oh, bless you. That's the roof safe before the next rain.

journalLog.10: Nia asked me to bring her a few sticks for repairs.
journalLog.20: I gathered the sticks Nia requested and should hand them over.
